Highest quality,briht light,
A photo-realistic shoot from a side angle about a white crossbody bag with the word "mosdoom" written on it, set against a backdrop of red curtains and a blue sky. the image also shows a white leather shoulder bag with a gold-tone metal clasp and a black strap, placed on a beige surface. the bag is positioned in the center of the image, with the red curtain in the background and the blue sky providing a striking contrast. the overall aesthetic is minimalistic and minimalistic, with a focus on the bag and its design.

Highest quality,briht light,
The image is a portrait of a young woman with long pink hair. She is standing in a garden with cherry blossom trees in full bloom in the background. The woman is wearing a long, flowing pink dress with a high neckline and long sleeves. The dress is made of a light pink fabric with a floral pattern and has a high slit on the side. She has a necklace and earrings on her neck and is posing with one hand on her hip and the other resting on her chest. Her hair is styled in loose waves and cascades over her shoulders. The overall mood of the image is elegant and romantic.

#147节点 整数这里是调节出图宽度，别搞太宽，768-1536
#160 节点 这里是属于描述二次打光的提示词，简单写一下就行
#158 节点 这里是调整二次打光的强度 正常0.2-0.7,就行，效果看着来

如果想每次运行更换一个背景请选择K采样器的（运行后操作）改为：randomize

默认设置是固定
